newsitem.title: ITALY: SGS-THOMSON said planning new Italy plant.
newsitem.headline: SGS-THOMSON said planning new Italy plant.

text.p: European semiconductor marker SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV is planning to build a new plant in Italy and this could be situated in the Cuneo area of the northwest Piedmont region.
The regional authority said in a statement after a meeting with the group's management that the plant would involve investment of around 2.0 trillion lire and could create some 1,000 jobs.
"The company's investment in Italy is a certainty and should take place in the second half of next year," a group director Enrico Villa said.

He said the sector in which the company worked was seen growing strongly and to cope with this SGS-Thomson would need new production bases. Along with Piedmont, the company was also looking at areas in southern Italy, an industry source said.
